description: Lists the projects this credential can act on. A project is one site or brand under the account, and every widget, lead, campaign and sequence belongs to one. Every other tool takes an optional project argument: pass one of these ids to run that call in that project. Without it, a call uses the connection's project (the row with current true) or, when no row is current, reads across the whole account. When there is more than one row and none is current, ask the user which website they mean and pass its id on each call.
name: list_projects
title: List projects
